subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: A 5-day Beijing tour with a 5-star hotel throughout. See Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City, visit Gubei Water Town (W Town) and the Simatai Great Wall at night with cable car, then the Temple of Heaven and Qianmen old street. Day 4 is free, or you can join the optional Universal Studios Beijing day.

placeDesc.Wangfujing Walking Street: A famous pedestrian shopping and snack street in central Beijing.
placeDesc.Tiananmen Square: One of the world's largest public squares, in the heart of Beijing.
placeDesc.Forbidden City: The vast former imperial palace of Ming and Qing emperors, now a world heritage site.
placeDesc.Gubei Water Town (W Town): A Chinese-style canal town at the foot of the Great Wall, with a night-time atmosphere and shows.
placeDesc.Simatai Great Wall: A rugged section of the Great Wall in the mountains northeast of Beijing, visited for its night view by cable car.
placeDesc.Zhenyuan Escort Agency: A traditional-style compound in Gubei Water Town themed on the old escort agencies of imperial China.
placeDesc.Temple of Heaven: A historic temple complex where Ming and Qing emperors held prayers for good harvests.
placeDesc.Qianmen Old Street: A restored traditional pedestrian street near Tiananmen with old shops and eateries.
placeDesc.Universal Studios Beijing: A large theme park resort in Beijing, offered as an optional whole-day visit on the free day.
